result.summary: The page is generally usable, but several horizontally scrolling elements are visibly clipped at the right edge, and icon-only controls create accessibility gaps.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel cuts off the third restaurant card at the right edge, partially hiding the restaurant name and delivery price.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance, increase side padding, or ensure peeking cards keep key text readable when partially visible.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons on restaurant cards appear to be icon-only buttons with no visible label or accessible name.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as 'Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites' and ensure focus states are visible.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped after 'Healthy', with the next chip only partly visible and no fade/scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add an edge fade, horizontal scroll indicator, or adjust chip spacing so truncation looks intentional.

issues.description: The lower 'Popular right now' card is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing mostly image and discount badge without context.
issues.suggestion: Increase vertical spacing or reduce card height so at least the restaurant title/metadata remains partially visible while scrolling.

issues.description: Promotional banner decorative circles sit close to the text block and slightly compete with the checkout code readability.
issues.suggestion: Reduce opacity or move decorative shapes further from the promo copy and CTA.
